extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet; BZT52C7V5S values were selected from the BZT52C7V5S row.
The nominal zener voltage curve was digitized from the 7.5 V trace in p. 3 Fig. 1 without interpolating between read locations.

The BZT52C7V5S row also specifies VZ minimum 7.0 V and maximum 7.9 V at IZT = 5 mA, ZZT maximum 15 ohm at IZT, ZZK maximum 80 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and temperature coefficient limits 2.5 to 5.3 mV/degC; these fields have no slots in the strict extraction schema.
omission_reason: No capacitance or reverse-recovery data is published for this zener family; zener impedance and temperature-coefficient columns are preserved in extraction notes because the strict schema has no corresponding fields.
